This approach is being led by teams like the Lucknow Leopards, which is setting a benchmark for others to follow. The development of pickleball in India is thus dependent on corporate funding for now.

Business.title: New platform to support cultural entrepreneurship in India
Business.summary: A new platform has been launched to support cultural entrepreneurship in India, aiming to address the gap in incubation, mentorship, and funding for startups in the cultural sector. This initiative recognizes the growth of India's startup ecosystem and the need to support entrepreneurs working in the cultural space. The platform will provide necessary resources to these entrepreneurs.

Business.title: Stage VCs Are Rethinking Investing as AI Rewrites Startup Economics
Business.summary: The impact of AI on startup funding is leading to a shift in the strategy of early-stage venture capitalists in India. They are now focusing on sector-specific investing, seeking deeper engagement and specialized expertise. This change reflects the maturing ecosystem of startups in India and the need for VCs to adapt to the new landscape.

Business.title: Zepto to raise pre-IPO funding amid delayed listing
Business.summary: Zepto has announced plans to raise funds through a pre-IPO financing round due to a delayed public listing. The company is seeking to raise capital amid a tepid response from investors to its initial public offering. This move indicates a change in Zepto's funding strategy as it navigates the challenges of going public.

Business.title: India startup funding slumps 57% in a week as big-ticket deals dry up
Business.summary: The funding for Indian startups has seen a significant decline, with a 57% drop in investments in just one week. The total investments raised by startups during July 24-30 were $80 million, indicating a sharp slowdown in early- and late-stage funding. Despite this, seed-stage activity showed stronger performance, highlighting the challenges faced by startups in securing larger investments.

National Affairs.title: Lawyers petition constitutional authorities for Justice Sandhawalia's elevation to Supreme Court
National Affairs.summary: A group of lawyers has petitioned the President, Chief Justice of India, and Union Law Minister to elevate Himachal Pradesh High Court Chief Justice GS Sandhawalia to the Supreme Court. The petition has been emailed to the authorities and a signature campaign is ongoing to gather more support. This development highlights the process of selecting judges for the Supreme Court.

National Affairs.title: Supreme Court denies Asaram medical bail, allows round-the-clock caretaker in jail
National Affairs.summary: The Supreme Court has denied medical bail to Asaram, who is currently in jail, despite his counsel arguing that his health is deteriorating due to multiple ailments. However, the court has allowed a round-the-clock caretaker to attend to him in jail. This decision reflects the court's approach to balancing health concerns with the need for justice.

National Affairs.title: Cruelty Doesn't Need a Marriage Certificate
National Affairs.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that women in live-in relationships are entitled to protection against cruelty, similar to those in formal marriages. This judgment emphasizes that constitutional rights and justice should not depend solely on marital status. The ruling aims to provide greater protection to women in informal relationships.

National Affairs.title: SC Appoints Ex-CJI DY Chandrachud As Mediator In Sunjay Kapur Estate Dispute
National Affairs.summary: The Supreme Court has appointed former Chief Justice of India DY Chandrachud as a mediator to resolve an inheritance dispute between the family members of late industrialist Sunjay Kapur. The court aims to find an amicable solution to the dispute through mediation. This approach highlights the court's efforts to resolve complex family disputes through alternative dispute resolution methods.

National Affairs.title: Ex-Tehelka editor Tarun Tejpal convicted in 2013 sexual assault case
National Affairs.summary: The Bombay High Court has overturned the acquittal of Tarun Tejpal, former editor of Tehelka, in a 2013 sexual assault case. Tejpal has stated that he will approach the Supreme Court to appeal the conviction. This case highlights the importance of the judiciary in ensuring justice for victims of sexual assault.

National Affairs.title: Supreme Court agrees to hear plea against 'Sansad Chalo' march organisers
National Affairs.summary: The Supreme Court has agreed to hear a petition related to the 'Sansad Chalo' march, which took place in Delhi on July 20. The petition emphasizes the need for restraint and community service for violators, and the court's decision to hear the plea may have implications for the organization of future protests. The case highlights the court's role in balancing the right to protest with the need for public order.

brief: Global oil prices have stabilized below $80 amid ongoing tensions over the Strait of Hormuz, with Iran and the US nearing a deal that could significantly impact global oil trade and geopolitical relations. Meanwhile, in India, the stock market has ended on a positive note due to easing crude prices and the Reserve Bank of India's steady policy stance, with the Sensex gaining 374 points. The RBI's decision to hold the policy rate steady has also led to a bond market rally, with investors closely watching the upcoming bond auction and the potential impact on interest rates and inflation.

Geopolitics.title: India's DPI model emerging as key pillar of digital diplomacy amid AI push: Report
Geopolitics.summary: India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) framework is emerging as a key tool in international digital diplomacy, especially with the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI). This development highlights India's growing influence in global digital governance. The DPI model could play a significant role in shaping international cooperation on digital issues.

Geopolitics.title: How the border village of Barmer is an international supplier of unique embroidery
Geopolitics.summary: The village of Barmer is known for its unique embroidery, which is supplied internationally. The craft is primarily sustained by Meghwal women who have passed down the tradition through generations. This embroidery not only preserves cultural heritage but also contributes significantly to the local handicraft economy.

Geopolitics.title: Iran, US say Strait of Hormuz deal is close, but one or both would have to back down
Geopolitics.summary: Iran and the US are nearing a deal regarding the Strait of Hormuz, but an agreement would require one or both parties to compromise. Iran seeks control over the strait, while the US aims to maintain it as an open international waterway. The outcome of these negotiations could significantly impact global oil trade and geopolitical relations.

Geopolitics.title: Oil price today: Crude steadies below $80 as Hormuz blockade keeps investors on edge
Geopolitics.summary: The price of crude oil has stabilized below $80 due to the ongoing blockade of the Strait of Hormuz. The situation is being closely monitored by investors as it affects global oil supply and prices. Efforts to resolve the US-Iran conflict and restore shipping through the strait are crucial for market stability.

Geopolitics.title: Not true: US War Secretary Pete Hegseth rejects media reports claiming US missile defence stockpiles 'dangerously low'
Geopolitics.summary: US War Secretary Pete Hegseth has denied reports suggesting that the US missile defense stockpiles are dangerously low. The reports were based on estimates by the Center for Strategic and International Studies, which claimed the US had limited numbers of THAAD missiles and Patriot interceptors. Hegseth's statement aims to reassure about the country's defense capabilities.

Economy.title: Indian markets end higher on easing crude prices, RBI policy support; Sensex gains 374 pts
Economy.summary: The Indian stock market ended on a positive note due to easing crude oil prices and the Reserve Bank of India's steady policy stance, with the Sensex gaining 374 points. This was also driven by selective buying in heavyweight, banking, and energy stocks. The market's positive movement is a reflection of the current economic conditions.

Economy.title: RBI policy-led India bond rally continues; Friday's debt sale in focus
Economy.summary: The Indian government bond market saw a slight increase due to the Reserve Bank of India's dovish stance and falling oil prices. Investors are cautious ahead of a significant bond auction on Friday, which will test market demand and the sustainability of the recent bond price gains. The outcome of the auction will be closely watched by market participants.

Economy.title: When is your home loan EMI increasing? RBI rate hike calls pushed back after dovish pause
Economy.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's decision to maintain current rates and lower inflation forecasts has led economists to push back their expectations for a rate hike to December or later. This means that home loan EMIs may not increase as soon as previously thought. The central bank's stance differs from other Asian economies, which are responding to oil price spikes.

Economy.title: FMCG price hikes could rewrite India’s inflation story: Report
Economy.summary: Planned price hikes by consumer goods companies could put pressure on inflation, despite the Reserve Bank of India's outlook. The RBI is expected to maintain interest rates through 2026, with a potential rate hike possible in early 2027 if inflation pressures intensify. The central bank's future policy decisions may be influenced by global central bank actions.

Economy.title: How market participants read RBI's order of priority has a bearing on how well monetary policy works
Economy.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's decision to hold the policy rate steady despite inflation risks has led to assumptions about the hierarchy of policy goals. The central bank must consider the potential consequences of this assumption and how it may impact the effectiveness of monetary policy. This has implications for the overall economy and the RBI's future policy decisions.

The court emphasized the importance of restraint and community service for violators, suggesting that youngsters involved in the protests may require counseling. The case raises questions about the balance between the right to protest and maintaining public order.

National Affairs.title: SC awards ₹83 lakh to girl left paralysed after road accident
National Affairs.summary: The Supreme Court has awarded ₹83 lakh in compensation to a girl who was left paralyzed after a road accident. The decision highlights the court's role in providing compensation to victims of accidents and ensuring that they receive adequate support for their rehabilitation. The amount awarded will likely help the girl cover her medical expenses and other needs.

brief: Today's key developments span multiple categories, with the ongoing US-Iran conflict and its implications for global oil markets being closely watched, as crude prices steady below $80 due to the blockade of the Hormuz Strait. Meanwhile, in India, the Reserve Bank of India has kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25%, raising growth projections and lowering inflation estimates, which has had a positive impact on the stock market. Additionally, the Indian startup ecosystem is experiencing significant changes, with a 57% drop in funding in just one week, and companies like Zepto exploring alternative funding options, while the Supreme Court has made notable decisions, including safeguarding live-in partners from domestic violence and passing a bill to increase the sanctioned strength of the Supreme Court from 34 to 38 judges.

Geopolitics.title: Oil price today: Crude steadies below $80 as Hormuz blockade keeps investors on edge
Geopolitics.summary: Oil prices have steadied below $80 due to the ongoing US-Iran conflict and the blockade of the Hormuz Strait, which is a critical shipping route. This development is being closely watched by investors and could have significant implications for global oil markets. The situation remains volatile, with markets waiting for a resolution to the conflict.

Geopolitics.title: Iran war depletes US missile stocks, raising concerns over readiness for conflict with China: Report
Geopolitics.summary: The US has reportedly depleted its stockpile of long-range precision missiles due to the ongoing war with Iran, raising concerns about its readiness for a potential conflict with China. This development has significant implications for US military capabilities and global geopolitics. The depletion of missile stocks could impact US strategic planning and decision-making.

Geopolitics.title: Arsenal of Freedom': US rushes to rebuild missile stock amid Iran war
Geopolitics.summary: The US military is working to rebuild its missile stock amid the ongoing conflict in Iran, as stockpiles have dwindled due to extensive use. This effort is crucial for maintaining US military capabilities and responding to potential future conflicts. The US is rushing to replenish its arsenal to ensure it can continue to project power and protect its interests.

Geopolitics.title: Iran's Pezeshkian Says Tehran Does Not Seek To Expand The War
Geopolitics.summary: Iranian leader Pezeshkian has stated that Tehran does not seek to expand the current conflict, marking a declaration of restraint from Iran's leadership. This statement is intended for both domestic and international audiences and aims to convey that Iran is not pursuing an escalation of the conflict. The remark is significant, as it could impact the trajectory of the conflict and regional tensions.

Economy.title: Repo rate unchanged, RBI sees higher growth, lower inflation
Economy.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% and raised its growth projections while lowering inflation estimates. This decision aims to maintain policy stability amid global uncertainties. The move is expected to have a positive impact on the economy.

Economy.title: RBI holds repo rate at 5.25%, raises FY27 growth forecast, cuts inflation outlook
Economy.summary: The RBI has kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% for the fourth consecutive time, raised its FY27 growth forecast to 6.7%, and lowered the inflation projection to 5%. The decision reflects the central bank's confidence in India's economic resilience despite global uncertainties. The revised loan pricing norms and plans to resume urban cooperative bank licenses are also notable.

Economy.title: Sensex gains 152 pts in volatile session as RBI keeps policy rates unchanged
Economy.summary: The benchmark BSE Sensex closed higher by 152 points in a volatile session after the RBI kept its key policy rates unchanged. The decision had a positive impact on the stock market, with the Sensex rising despite global uncertainties. The move is seen as a sign of stability in the economy.

Business.title: Swiggy, Eternal Surge As Zepto's IPO Valuation Reset Raises Market Share Hopes
Business.summary: The proposed IPO valuation cut and funding constraints of Zepto have raised hopes for its competitors, Swiggy and Eternal, to gain market share in India's quick commerce sector. Investors are betting that Zepto's slower expansion will benefit listed rivals, leading to a surge in their shares. This development highlights the competitive landscape of India's quick commerce market.

National Affairs.title: Supreme Court safeguards for live-in partners are much-needed and long-overdue
National Affairs.summary: The Supreme Court has taken steps to protect live-in partners from domestic violence, a pervasive yet under-reported crime in India. According to NFHS-6, over 22% of ever-married women have experienced physical, sexual, or emotional violence at the hands of their partners. This move aims to provide much-needed protection to live-in partners.

National Affairs.title: Supreme Court acquits man in jail for 22 years for wrong conviction
National Affairs.summary: The Supreme Court has acquitted a man who was wrongly convicted and spent 22 years in jail. The acquittal was due to the trial court's failure to evaluate evidence properly and the Odisha High Court's inaction. This case highlights the need for proper evaluation of evidence in the justice system.

National Affairs.title: Decide on raising retirement age of judges by Sept 2: SC to states
National Affairs.summary: The Supreme Court has asked states to decide on raising the retirement age of judges by September 2. This move aims to bring the retirement age of judicial officers in line with that of High Court judges. The decision will help ensure that experienced judges can continue to serve the justice system.

National Affairs.title: ‘Criminal cases can’t have lifespan of turtle’: Supreme Court on activist’s trial delay
National Affairs.summary: The Supreme Court has expressed concern over the delay in the trial of an activist, stating that the lifespan of a criminal trial cannot be as long as that of a turtle. The trial has been ongoing for over three years, highlighting the need for a more efficient justice system.

National Affairs.title: Rajya Sabha passes by voice vote bill to raise Supreme Court judge strength
National Affairs.summary: The Rajya Sabha has passed a bill to increase the sanctioned strength of the Supreme Court from 34 to 38 judges. The bill replaces an ordinance that was promulgated earlier this year and aims to strengthen the judiciary. The move is expected to help reduce the backlog of cases in the Supreme Court.

National Affairs.title: Rajya Sabha clears Bill raising SC judges' strength
National Affairs.summary: The Rajya Sabha has passed the Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill, 2026, increasing the sanctioned strength of the apex court from 34 to 38 judges. The bill had already been passed by the Lok Sabha and aims to strengthen the judiciary by adding more judges to the Supreme Court.
